narrative.overview: The existing burgundy school identity, original wordmark and clay learning materials anchor a calm, legible Arabic RTL workspace. Warm paper surfaces support preparation, teaching and observation; quieter olive rooms keep the learner's immediate task central. This records the approved implementation direction and the actual build. Generated concepts supplied the visual target and production imagery; full-page pixel fidelity has not been measured.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic RTL structure with clear Arabic typography and deliberate mixed-direction fields.
Burgundy identity, warm paper panels and clay imagery grounded in teaching materials.
Compact teacher navigation and immediate actions; quiet learner surfaces.
Real catalog content, functional settings and existing access rules.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original logo, burgundy identity and catalog imagery. The configurable brand color continues to drive the primary wine token; status also requires readable text.

dos: **Do** preserve the original logo, burgundy identity, Arabic RTL structure and real catalog content.
**Do** keep status text, visible focus and functional selected states alongside color.
**Do** preserve learner preferences and platform access rules when refining presentation.
**Do** inspect the final desktop, phone and dark-mode surfaces, and report verification gaps honestly.
donts: **Don't** treat unmeasured mockup reproduction as pixel-exact fidelity or fictional profiles as real student evidence.
**Don't** introduce fake controls or remove existing settings to imitate a mockup.
**Don't** transfer web values to the separate native app without inspecting its own implementation.
**Don't** treat successful tests or bundling as complete visual or accessibility verification.
